facts.title: Autumn Kale Salad with Fennel, Honeycrisp and Goat Cheese
ingredients: 1 very large bunch or 2 small bunches (12 ounces total) curly green kale
3 ounces chilled goat cheese, crumbled (to yield about ⅓ cup crumbled goat cheese)
¼ cup pepitas (pumpkin seeds) or chopped pecans
Several twists of freshly ground black pepper
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
